items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I know they had some bad women too back, I think too, you know. Mary Jack the Bear.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Yeah. And, uh, did I ask you about Aaron Harris? Aaron. Aaron Harris. He was a bad, bad man. No, I just can't praise him, huh? Sawadick? Who? Sawadick was one of them. That's what his nickname was. That I heard about him. Well, you know, they were all in a bunch, Black Benny and, and Aaron Harris and Sawadick and all those guys. Mm-hmm. That's a big point. Yeah.
I know they had some bad women too back, I think too, you know. Mary Jack the Bear.
Well, she killed Black Benny, didn't she? She's the one who killed Black Benny. Yeah.
